Form No.3
C. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. REGISTRY. No. D. 5770 Date 29 / 3 / 34）

Subject (in full)........................................Miss A.V. Leonova, Soviet Employee.

Made by....D.S. Tcheremshansky....................Forwarded by....[签名]

* See also
File D. 5767

Alexandra Vassilievna Leonova, an employee of the
U.S.S.R. Consulate-General, arrived at Shanghai accompanied
by one L.A. Granat, employee of the Far Eastern Bank (Dalbank),
on March 25, 1934 by the s.s. "Empress of Russia". She is a
Russian, 33 years of age and holds U.S.S.R. passport No.10752
issued on 10.2.34 at Moscow.

It is reported that Miss Leonova and Granat were
originally passengers on board the Soviet s.s. "Kuznetsky Less"
which went aground on March 11, 1934 near the Pratas light
house on its way to Vladivostok. They were taken to Hongkong
by the British warship Keswick.

Her present address is unknown.

g Tcheremshansky
D. S.

[签名]
Deputy Commissioner.
Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别科
报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处中央与特别科档案室。编号 D. 5770 日期 34年3月29日）

事由（全称）........................................A.V. 列昂诺娃小姐，苏联雇员。

制作人....D.S. 切列姆尚斯基....................转呈人....[签名]

* 另见
档案 D. 5767

亚历山德拉·瓦西里耶夫娜·列昂诺娃，苏联驻上海总领事馆雇员，于1934年3月25日由“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船抵达上海，同行者为远东银行（Dalbank）雇员L.A. 格拉纳特一人。她系俄罗斯人，现年33岁，持有1934年2月10日在莫斯科签发的苏联护照第10752号。

据报，列昂诺娃小姐与格拉纳特原为苏联“库兹涅茨基·莱斯”号轮船上的乘客，该船于1934年3月11日在驶往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）途中，于普拉塔斯灯塔附近搁浅。他们由英国军舰“凯斯威克”号送往香港。

其目前住址不详。

g 切列姆尚斯基
D. S.

[签名]
副总监。
特别科。
